claims: The NYSE and Nasdaq are closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
There will be no trading sessions on the NYSE and Nasdaq on April 3, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will reopen for regular hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The bond market will close early at 12 p.m. ET on April 3, 2026.
The London Stock Exchange is closed on April 3, 2026.
Euronext Paris is closed on April 3, 2026.
Most major banks are open on April 3, 2026.
The U.S. Postal Service is open on April 3, 2026.
The next scheduled stock market holiday is Memorial Day on Monday, May 25, 2026.
